checks.label: C1: Payoff in header, content starts by second 3
checks.description: State the payoff in the header and get into the actual content by second 3. Skip any context setting.

checks.label: C2: Show a number or column in the first slate (Excel/calculator reels)
checks.description: For Excel and calculator reels, show at least one column of numbers in the first slate, under a 'How much X do you need for Y' header. A curiosity header with no numbers performs worse.
signals: how much X do you need header

checks.label: C3: Static, readable header on screen from 0:00 for 4+ sec
checks.description: Keep the header on screen from 0:00 for at least 4 seconds, at the top of the frame, in static, readable type. Headers that flash by or are animated raise skip.

checks.label: C4: Make it look raw
checks.description: Shoot handheld on the phone back camera, show the real screen and keep the edit light, especially for topicals. Raw-looking reels beat flashy feed versions on skip, shares and follows.

checks.label: C5: Post topicals inside the news cycle
checks.description: Post topical reels while the news is still live. If it's late, drop it rather than posting.

checks.label: C6: Open with a firm statement or fact
checks.description: Open with an affirmative statement or fact. Avoid 'might', 'maybe' or question hooks.

checks.label: C7: Recognisable logos or products in the first frame
checks.description: Show logos or products people already recognise in the first frame. This cut skip by 6 to 8 points; unfamiliar or missing logos did worse.

checks.label: C8: PS on screen in the first 3 sec and for most of the reel
checks.description: Get PS on screen within the first 3 seconds and keep them there for most of the reel. Reels where PS was off screen for 20+ seconds lost retention.

checks.label: C9: Checklists name a personal consequence; lead with the least-known point
checks.description: For checklist reels, the header should name a personal consequence (e.g. 'to not get rejected'). Lead with the least-known point and keep point 1 under 12 seconds.

checks.label: C10: Rankings use S/A/B tiers, 5+ items, short reasons, one tier open
checks.description: Use standard S/A/B tiers with 5 or more items and one-line reasons of 10 seconds max each. Leave one tier empty until the end so viewers stay for the last reveal.

checks.label: C11: Test 2 hook versions on trial reels, 2+ hrs apart, one change only
checks.description: Test hooks with two versions on trial reels at the same time, posted at least 2 hours apart, changing only one thing. Trials posted back to back tanked.

checks.label: C13: Visual hook lands early; payoff header readable in first seconds
checks.description: The visual hook and payoff header should land in the opening seconds so viewers know what they get. When the hook is slow, unclear or the payoff header is late, skip rises sharply.

checks.label: C12: CTA at the end, kept short
checks.description: Put the CTA at the end and keep it short. Mid-reel CTAs caused immediate retention drops.

antiChecks.label: A1: Spending the opening on context, or VO reading the header
antiChecks.description: Don't spend the opening setting context or have the VO read out the header. These reels lost most viewers within seconds.
signals: point pe aane mein time laga

antiChecks.label: A2: Header and VO promise different payoffs
antiChecks.description: Don't let the header and the VO promise different things. Keep one payoff and phrase it two ways.
signals: header kuch aur, VO kuch aur
unclear what the reel is about

antiChecks.label: A3: Fast zooms, flashy edits or moving subtitles in the first 3 sec
antiChecks.description: Avoid fast zooms, flashy Shorts-style edits, quick B-roll cuts or moving subtitles in the first 3 seconds. The same reel re-hooked on a stable frame did far better.
signals: too many things in first 3 seconds

antiChecks.label: A4: Cluttered zero slate (4+ elements)
antiChecks.description: Don't open on a zero slate with 4 or more elements. Car calculators were the one exception, so test before applying this to calculators.
signals: PS, article, header all in one

antiChecks.label: A5: Polished, stylised or promotional look
antiChecks.description: Don't make it look polished, stylised or promotional, such as stylised header fonts, character-style edits or ad-like logo setups. These read as ads and raised skip.

antiChecks.label: A6: Negative/flipped rankings or ranking unfamiliar things
antiChecks.description: Don't use negative or flipped rankings (F to A), and don't rank things people don't already know.
signals: topic and format feel like a force fit
log ko pata hi nahi kya rank ho raha

antiChecks.label: A7: Exact re-upload
antiChecks.description: Don't post an exact re-upload. Change the footage and the first 3 seconds, not just the hook; hook-only changes still got reach capped.

antiChecks.label: C13 miss: Visual hook missed or slow
antiChecks.description: When the visual hook is weak, slow or the payoff header lands late, skip rises. Often called out separately from generic payoff-first issues.
signals: no clear hook in first seconds

antiChecks.label: A8: '3 checks' / '3 ways' opening without a personal stake
antiChecks.description: Don't open with '3 checks' or '3 ways' unless it carries a personal stake for the viewer. Generic list hooks had some of the worst skip rates.
